role: Small task/reference diagnostic; not an unexposed blind evaluation or model promotion.
aAControl: raw-a/raw-b from the same frozen birth state, equivalent tools and decoding; estimate natural variation before attributing harm to compression.
pairing: Same source input/state and reader version/channel/tools/decoding; only raw/reference historical reasoning differs. Reused or copied provider observations do not create independent executions.
independence: Task/repository/template/call lineage clusters; independentSampleCount remains null without a separately reviewed sampling account.
denominator: Frozen complete case registry. Missing/failed/timeout/refused/fallback outcomes stay in the report; never score only successful compressions.
deterministicControls: retained ctx ledger versus new evidence
semanticBoundary: Coverage maps and explicit AI labels are review evidence, not an automatic entailment oracle. Deterministic controls alone cannot mark this ruler VALID.
continuationOutcomes: total uncached/cached prompt and completion tokens
economicAccounting: Compare cumulative target paths, including cache changes, student CPU, metadata/handles, readback and retries. Character ratio is descriptive only; estimates are not bills.
validityPrerequisites: harmful fluent controls correctly rejected by full review
real original-receiver A/A and reference/raw paired results
stopRules: actual payload does not carry candidate: fix integration, no SFT
carefully reviewed references lack useful net gains: revise task/length, no SFT
ruler leaks bad controls or rejects equivalent references: repair new ruler, keep old INVALID
CPU budget or backend fails: retire candidate, no mass training
